name: Phantom Queen

generation.prompt:
A cinematic, wide shot of the Phantom Queen seated on a throne of twisted, iridescent obsidian and frozen moonlight. She is a silhouette of ethereal elegance, her face veiled in shimmering, translucent gossamer that obscures her features. She wears a sweeping gown of midnight velvet that dissolves into a swirling mist of indigo and silver smoke at the hem. 

The setting is a surreal Otherworld court: a cathedral of weeping willow branches and floating amethyst shards under a perpetual twilight sky. Soft, haunting luminescence emanates from floating lanterns. The atmosphere is heavy with mystery and dread, characterized by deep purples, cold silvers, and void-black shadows. Ethereal particles of light drift like dust in the air, emphasizing a mood of silent, oppressive royalty.

gmNotes: Phantom Queen is a title archetype held by the ruler of a Fey court. A title does not imply the holder's Species — record the holder's Species and archetypes on their character file rather than assuming from the title. Do not disclose the current holder's identity or origin in player-facing material. The title grants no automatic mechanics.
description: A queen of the Otherworld known as the Phantom — a figure of rumor and dread whose court deals in debts, secrets, and the cost of promises. Few have seen her face; everyone has heard her name.
